entities.name: Query NrdI
observations: The 140-residue sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt protein NrdI Q1GJB3 from Ruegeria sp. TM1040.
NrdI is probably involved in ribonucleotide reductase function.
The sequence contains a Flavodoxin_NrdI domain (PF07972.17) spanning residues 5–121.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is 15,243 Da and theoretical pI is 9.38.

entities.name: NrdI
observations: Reviewed NrdI homologs from Paracoccus denitrificans and Rhizobium leguminosarum show 65.7% and 56.9% identity, respectively, with full or near-full coverage.
Curated homolog annotations associate NrdI with FMN binding (GO:0010181).
NrdI is probably involved in ribonucleotide reductase function.

entities.name: NrdI FMN binding
observations: FMN binding is supported by curated homolog annotations under GO:0010181; no explicit catalytic reaction equation was retrieved.
The protein is a small, basic, soluble-looking flavodoxin-like protein based on sequence composition and the absence of a predicted membrane segment in the reported analysis.
